subject: Request: short demo buffer while procurement verifies PO
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Holt <lauren.holt@medigen.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short demo buffer while procurement verifies PO

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, your procurement team is validating the PO and expects final sign-off later this week. We don’t want your engineers to lose momentum while procurement finishes the review.

Would it help if we provisioned a short demo buffer (5 days of expanded tokens + access for two additional seats) to keep your integration tests running while the PO clears?

If that sounds good, I can route the approval through my manager today. We’d just need:
- confirmation of the primary billing contact (name/email)
- a quick copy of the PO draft (if possible) so finance can match the request

I’ve attached the screenshot we promised and included the latest PO draft you shared.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks — much appreciated. Procurement is doing a cross-check with our legal team; they asked for one more line in the PO about data residency and a copied SLA section. That should be a quick patch but it pushed us into a verification queue. We expect sign-off by Friday (6/4) but want to be conservative.

A short buffer would be extremely helpful. Can you hold a 7-day buffer? We need to keep two more test seats active for our engineers this week and weekend.

Primary billing contact is Amit Shah (amit.shah@medigen.com). I attached the most recent redline.

—Lauren
Lauren Holt
Director of Engineering, Medigen Therapeutics

Looping in Kimberly for a quick approval path.

- 7 days starting 6/4/2027
- 2 additional developer seats (temporary)
- token allotment: +150k tokens for demo environment

Kimberly — can you confirm we’re OK to issue this as a one-time promotional credit tied to DEAL-8742? If so I’ll create the internal approval ticket and note the billing contact (Amit Shah).

Thanks —
